description: Weigh any decision: list pros and cons with importance weights, get a scored verdict and a visual breakdown.

faqs.a: Each pro and con gets a weight from 1 (minor) to 5 (deal-breaker). Totals are compared to produce the verdict.
If the weighted totals are within 10% of each other, the result is a toss-up — the decision genuinely could go either way.
Yes — add as many rows as you need on either side.
faqs.q: Can I add more pros and cons?

faqs.a: Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.

howto: Type the decision you are weighing.
Add pros and cons, each with an importance weight of 1–5.
Read the verdict and the weighted score breakdown.
title: Pros & Cons Decider
